issues.where: the pale shore animals, especially the nearest one on the right, from loop frames 44 to 305
issues.what: the bodies shift along the shore, but the long legs retain much the same spread and no planted foot is easy to pick out; the animals read as sliding more than stepping
issues.fix: Hold each planted foot in place while the body moves over it, then stagger the lifts, pauses, and turns across the group.

issues.where: the low fog bank to the right of the front rib, frames 0 to 120
issues.what: the foreground sea changes shape, but the fog keeps the same broad diagonal streaks as the framing creeps forward, so it reads more like a fixed layer than heavy air flowing around the ribs
issues.fix: Let the bank pool against the rib bases, peel off the far sides, and break into low eddies at a different pace from the camera move.

issues.where: the right-hand spiral and the wisps over the ribs in the orbital hold, frames 11623 to 11743
issues.what: the glow dims and the view drifts, but the spiral and nearby wisps keep almost the same outlines and stay pinned to the ground markings, making the hold read like a dimming still
issues.fix: Give the high cloud and storm bands subtle, independent drift against the terrain without speeding up the orbital move.
